description: Qualité de l'eau de distribution - Wallonie is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SPW ARNE. Un outil cartographique permet à chaque citoyenne et citoyen de s’informer facilement sur la qualité de l’eau distribuée à son robinet, à partir de son adresse. Les informations présentées sont centralisées pour l’ensemble du territoire wallon, et couvrent toutes les zones de distribution d’eau potable. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Farming, Environment. Its keywords are eau. The portal shows 641 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
